**Liferay DXP** is a Java based, open source enterprise portal used by businesses to create intranet and extranets.

The latest Quarterly Release of Liferay DXP 2026.Q1 is DXP 2026.Q1.0.

* [Docker Image](https://hub.docker.com/r/liferay/dxp/tags?page=1&name=2026.q1.0-lts)
	* `docker pull liferay/dxp:2026.q1.0-lts`
* [Documentation](https://learn.liferay.com/w/dxp/index)
* [Release Notes](https://support.liferay.com/e/release-notes/release-highlights/20004/27626917?r=27626917)
* Release date: Mar 18, 2026
